gap_analysis.objective: Three LLM participants play six simultaneous public-goods rounds with a known endowment withdrawal after round 3; measure how contributions adapt while savings remain spendable.

requirement.description: Six simultaneous rounds with one joint contribution batch per round and no sequential phases.

decisions.reason: simultaneous.v1 runs every actor in one joint batch per round for a fixed number of rounds, exactly matching the six simultaneous contribution rounds.

requirement.description: Three live LLM actors with neutral own-wealth objectives, private memory, and no prescribed strategy.

decisions.reason: llm.v1 carries shared scientific instructions plus a private typed behavior profile per actor, with permission-filtered observations and memory; transport is resolved centrally.

requirement.description: One scalar contribution per actor per round with an explicit contribution field.

decisions.reason: No approved action schema names a public-goods contribution; an explicit contribution field keeps contributions distinct from balances and payoffs in every payload.

requirement.description: Endowment withdrawal schedule, savings-funded budget legality, public-goods payoffs, and public round feedback for varied N, horizons, endowments, and multipliers.
required_guarantees: no double counting of wealth and payoff

decisions.reason: No approved mechanism implements endowment schedules, savings-funded budgets, or public-goods payoffs; recording.v1 collects actions without any economic model, and Bertrand/Stackelberg/normal-form rules do not match.

requirement.description: Mathematical reference trajectories: finite-horizon zero-contribution benchmark and full-reinvestment group-wealth reference with marginal private return.

decisions.reason: Both references are closed-form arithmetic needing no search or solver API, so plain utility functions with stated assumptions are the smallest coherent form.

requirement.description: Offline preview plus final explanatory report with trajectories, withdrawal marker, phase statistics, comparisons, rationales, assumptions, and limitations.

decisions.reason: New preview/final generator functions in experiment_extension.report extend the generic simulation_core.reports writers with domain narrative, calculated references, and figures from recorded results.

components.purpose: Six-round public-goods settlement with known endowment withdrawal: budget legality, payoff formula, saved balances, public round feedback.

acceptance_tests.name: test_mechanism_budget_legality
acceptance_tests.expected: Contributions within available funds accepted, including over-20 with savings and all-in after withdrawal; over-budget, negative, and malformed batches rejected.
acceptance_tests.reference: Hand-derived budget cases in tests/test_mechanism.py computed from the request payoff and availability rules.

acceptance_tests.name: test_mechanism_payoff_identity
acceptance_tests.expected: Payoffs equal endowment minus contribution plus pool share; closing balances equal opening plus payoff; aggregate wealth identity holds.
acceptance_tests.reference: Hand-derived payoff and wealth-identity cases in tests/test_mechanism.py for request and varied parameters.

acceptance_tests.name: test_mechanism_withdrawal_boundary
acceptance_tests.expected: Round 3 (tick 2) pays the endowment and round 4 (tick 3) pays zero; history records one entry per committed round.
acceptance_tests.reference: Round-indexing cases at the 3/4 boundary in tests/test_mechanism.py.

components.purpose: Typed scalar contribution payload with an explicit contribution field, separating contributions from wealth accounting.

acceptance_tests.name: test_contribution_payload_contract
acceptance_tests.expected: Mechanism publishes one contribute kind per actor typed as ContributionPayload with a single contribution field.

components.purpose: Closed-form mathematical reference trajectories (zero-contribution and full-reinvestment) plus marginal private return; plain functions, no solver.

acceptance_tests.name: test_reference_trajectories_closed_form
acceptance_tests.expected: Zero path ends at 60 and full-reinvestment path at 2240 per actor for request values; marginal private return equals multiplier/N.
acceptance_tests.reference: Hand-derived trajectory values in tests/test_references.py, independent of execution helpers.
